_comment: Sample config. Pass with --config. CLI flags override these. For a Kotlin/Fabric mod keep rewriteKotlinMetadata=true and list your root package(s).
_targeted: Optional: encrypt ONLY matching strings (e.g. hide just a URL). Leave both empty for normal behaviour. Set stringEncryptionChance:0 to encrypt ONLY these.
_hiding: Opt-in extra hardening. hideStringsCondy hides string literals behind CONSTANT_Dynamic (no plaintext, no visible decoder; needs class v55+, else falls back to inline decoder). antiDecompile wraps methods in behaviour-neutral opaque handlers that confuse CFR/Vineflower (does NOT hide from javap). Test the obfuscated jar before shipping.
